channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Harris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Harris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monty Williams on Joe Harris
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Monty Williams:

“Joe (Harris) is starting to look like the Joe that I used to fear in scouting reports.”

Monty Williams on Joe Harris, Oct 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Steve Nash on Joe Harris
item.description:
Adam Zagoria:Nash on Joe Harris's status:

“I don't think we know yet [when he'll be back] so I couldn't answer.”

Steve Nash on Joe Harris, Jan 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Joe Harris
item.description:
Blake Griffin says,

“Every time Joe (Harris) shoots I think that it’s going in — I have a lot of confidence in him.”

Blake Griffin on Joe Harris, Jun 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @ajayibrowne.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Joe Harris
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on Nets' sharpshooter Joe Harris:

“I was fortunate to have him in Cleveland ... as time went on, he got better and better.... his shooting ability makes them a different team.”

Tyronn Lue on Joe Harris, Feb 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Michael Malone on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Caris LeVert, Joe Harris
item.description:
Malone on the Nets:

“Kevin Durant, the guy is virtually unguardable... Caris LeVert, since Kyrie Irving has been gone, is playing at an incredibly high level. Joe Harris seems to never miss. Jarred Allen playing at a high level.”

Michael Malone on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Caris LeVert, Joe Harris, Jan 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Sean Marks on Joe Harris
item.description:
GM Sean Marks on Joe Harris resigning as the longest-tenured - and third highest-paid - Net:

“While we celebrate all that Joe has accomplished in his career up until this point, we’re also eagerly looking ahead to the next chapter of his career in Brooklyn.”

Sean Marks on Joe Harris, Nov 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Sean Marks on Joe Harris
item.description:
Brian Lewis:#Nets GM Sean Marks on resigning Joe Harris:

“That’s definitely a priority. We hope we can continue to build this with Joe…It would certainly be great to have him continue this ride with us.”

Sean Marks on Joe Harris, Nov 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Nash on Joe Harris, Jarrett Allen
item.description:
“Ky is a weapon off the ball. Kevin can play all five positions and I plan to use him in all five positions. I get excited to use some of the guys on the roster Caris, DJ, Jarrett Allen, Joe Harris,”

Steve Nash on Joe Harris, Jarrett Allen, Sep 17, 2020. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Dzanan Musa on Garrett Temple, Joe Harris
item.description:
During the NBA stoppage, the Nets have shared their feelings about social issues on group telephone and video chats.

“I learned a lot, especially from Garrett Temple and Joe Harris, who were talking a lot about the situation and how it was before,”

Dzanan Musa on Garrett Temple, Joe Harris, Jul 6, 2020. Source: Newsday.

item.title: JJ Redick on Joe Harris
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:J.J. Redick on Joe Harris:

“Joe is a guy I have a tremendous amount of respect for. If I kind of look across the league and think about my favorite players to watch, Joe is one of them.”

JJ Redick on Joe Harris, Apr 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Joe Harris
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jared Dudley on Joe Harris:

“You look at him, white guy, 6-4, 6-5, doesn’t look like a ballplayer. Next thing you know he’s got 18 points & he’s going at you... The sky’s the limit. People don’t really take him serious: After he has 16, hits three or four 3s then they do.”

Jared Dudley on Joe Harris, Dec 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.
